points.description: Describes the feature-extraction part of a CNN: input image, a convolutional layer whose kernels/filters convolve over the image, followed by a non-linear activation layer (ReLU), and a pooling layer (max or average pooling). Equivalent wording accepted; naming these layers in the correct order earns the mark.
points.partial_credit: Half if only some of these layers (e.g. convolution and pooling but no activation) are given, or the layers are named without the kernel/convolution description.

points.description: Describes the classification part: one or more fully connected layers followed by a final output layer (e.g. softmax/output classification layer). Equivalent wording accepted.
points.partial_credit: Half if fully connected layers are mentioned but the final output layer is missing, or vice versa.
